title: Representational Change Under Self-Consuming Training: A Sparse Autoencoder Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.21348v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly exposed to model-generated text, raising the possibility that future models will be trained recursively on the outputs of their predecessors. Prior work on such self-consuming training loops has largely focused on output quality and downstream performance, leaving their effects on internal representations poorly understood. We study how representations evolve across five generations of self-consumption and whether sparse autoencoders (SAEs) remain reliable under this shift. At each generation, we compare a lineage trained on synthetic data with a matched control trained on real data under the same training settings. We evaluate how well SAEs trained before self-consumption transfer to later generations, measuring reconstruction and sparsity across SAE widths, architectures, and model layers. translated_title: 自消耗训练下的表征变化：稀疏自编码器分析
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地接触到模型生成的文本，这引发了未来模型可能在上一代模型输出上进行递归训练的可能性。先前关于这种自消耗训练循环的研究主要聚焦于输出质量和下游性能，而其对内部表征的影响尚缺乏深入理解。我们研究了表征在五代自消耗过程中的演变方式，以及稀疏自编码器（SAE）在这一转变下是否依然可靠。在每一代中，我们将基于合成数据训练的模型谱系与在相同训练设置下基于真实数据训练的匹配对照组进行比较。我们评估了在自消耗发生之前训练的SAE向后续各代迁移的效果，并在不同的SAE宽度、架构和模型层上测量了重建质量与稀疏性。随后，我们在每一代模型上对原始SAE进行微调，并利用稀疏探测来检验任务相关的特征（此处摘要不完整）
tldr: 该论文首次利用稀疏自编码器系统考察了模型自消耗训练循环中内部表征的跨代演变，发现在多代自消耗后，先前训练的SAE的可靠性会随代际推移而下降，揭示了自消耗训练对模型内部表征结构的深层影响。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first sparse-autoencoder-based analysis of how internal representations evolve across generations of self-consuming training loops, showing that SAEs trained before self-consumption become increasingly unreliable over generations, thereby revealing the deep impact of self-consuming training on model representations.
